meaning:
Someone descended from Agag, a man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.15.8
Group of a.gag (אֲגָג "Agag" H0090H)
§ Agagite = "I will overtop"
said of Haman, Haman the Agagite

elsewhere.note: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes who were with him.
